chunks.text: Back in 2025 I spent a few days in Chongqing and ended up chatting with locals about which clinics people usually go to there.
Around that same trip I also got curious about how people there buy everyday meds—like what’s common over the counter versus what needs a prescription.
Later in 2025 I was in Shanghai for work and everyone in the office kept talking about what sports events were happening in the city that week.
Oh and during a weekend visit to Suzhou, I remember we kept debating what was even playing in town and which cinemas were decent.
My cousin told me she’d already arranged a doctor visit for Deng Hui with Peng Hui on 2025-05-09 in the morning, so that was all sorted without me doing anything.
And my coworker Mia Anderson said she’d already gotten herself one ticket for "CSL: Shanghai Port vs Shandong Taishan" in the Home Stand—she was excited because she likes sitting with the home crowd.
